_comment: A Prince of Persia project needs no file of its own: the game is the release's original data, which the project brings as firmware (the core's firmware list, by the version setting). A project may add a custom level set, a saved game of the original game's own, and an SDLPoP quicksave to start from.

slots.title: Custom levels
slots.help: A LEVELS.DAT of a custom level set (from a level editor or a mod), played in place of the original levels; the rest of the game is still the release's original data. Leave it empty for the original game.

slots.title: Saved game
slots.help: A PRINCE.SAV the original game saved (Ctrl+G, from level 3 on): the level, the minutes left and the hit points. Load Game (Ctrl+L on the title) resumes it. The game's own saves during the run are kept in the run, not written anywhere.

slots.title: Savestate
slots.help: An SDLPoP quicksave (QUICKSAVE.SAV, saved with F6 in SDLPoP 1.16 or later): the run starts from it - the whole level as it was, the prince, the guard, the time and the random seed - on the first tick, instead of on the title.
